lessons.text: Moderate arm scaling (~1.0–1.05), reduced travel, and timed short body squashes or hops kept movement complete, within range, and quantitatively framed; simple side-arm accents read well.
Overhead arm overrides at raise_=180 still rendered the mittens beside the hair, not above it; body and hit overrides failed to register several overhead and crossing accents.

Low inward arm poses can bury substantial portions of both tubes inside the body, while across-body poses place hands over the face instead of at the belly or chest; inspect geometry, not just quantitative checks.
The framing check reported no out-of-picture frames even when visual inspection showed clipped mitten tips; inspect wide reaches visually and limit travel or draw reaching arms inward.
Use explicit per-side arm poses for strongly asymmetric accents; mirrored side guesses give the wrong reaching arm even when overall motion checks pass.

Strong, short squash or hop body moves synchronized with accents can raise hit detection while preserving range and framing; both-arm overhead and hands-together-chest poses make key silhouettes clearer.
Hand-together and across-chest overrides can still leave the mittens apart or bury sections of the arm in the body; geometry checks reported up to 11 cm of arm penetration on these poses.
The quantitative in-frame check can pass even when rendered hands touch or leave the picture edge; inspect outward reaches visually, and verify overhead hands clear the hair.

runs.reviewer: The sideward and single-arm hits read well. The crossed-arm and overhead hits need clearer hand placement, with the arms kept visible and in front of the body.

proposals.change: Improve arm-to-body collision and hand-meeting alignment for hands_together_chest and across_chest, keeping each arm curved outside the body except intended surface contact.
proposals.why: Geometry checks repeatedly found deep arm penetration on chest-gathering poses (up to 11 cm); visual reviews also showed hands failing to meet at accents despite explicitly requesting them.

proposals.change: Investigate posed arm collision and pose mapping: keep low chest-gathering arms outside the body's surface, let both hands meet at belly/chest without rising to the face, and enable straight overhead arms to extend their mitten tips above the hair.
proposals.why: Across multiple inspected attempts, the arm-geometry checker found up to 11 cm of body penetration in low and crossing poses; explicit 180-degree overhead targets still appeared beside the hair.
